title: HB22 (2019 Regular): Firearms; revise limits placed on counties and municipalities to regulate.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2019/html/HB/0001-0099/HB0022IN.htm)
provenance.note: Introduced text as filed (2019); no passage vote recorded. The bill STRIKES (not adds): 45-9-53 subsections (4) and (5) (limits on county/municipal written notices under 45-9-101(13), and the right to sue and Attorney General review); and the 97-37-7(2) sentence letting licensed enhanced-carry holders carry in courthouses and 45-9-101(13) locations. Quotes show surviving text in those sections that the changes leave in place. Section 3 brings forward 45-9-101 (permit law) unchanged, not quoted.
